chunks: And from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) that he said:
Just as there is nothing to gain with polytheism, so there is nothing to lose with faith.

key_terms.الْإِيمَانِ: Faith; belief in God and the divine message
key_terms.يَنْفَعُ: To benefit; to be of use or gain

ai.seo_question: What is the effect of polytheism and faith on a believer's deeds according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) articulates a principle of spiritual sufficiency and exclusivity, emphasizing that Tawhid acts as an absolute shield against detriment, while Shirk nullifies all merit. This hadith is central to Shia theological discourse on the hierarchy of virtues, establishing faith not merely as a prerequisite but as the dominant factor that overrides minor sins or worldly losses. It reflects the Shia emphasis on the intrinsic power of Iman to preserve the believer's status regardless of external circumstances.
